comfy_url.description: ComfyUI endpoint reachable from the AstrBot container (required)

api_token.description: Optional ComfyUI reverse-proxy bearer token; never include in bug reports

job_timeout.description: Monitoring timeout seconds; does not interrupt the shared ComfyUI server

image_retention_days.description: Reusable image lifetime in days (1–365); expired library files are cleaned on startup and LLM requests

quiet_image_replies.description: Quiet image replies: deliver images without a follow-up LLM status message
quiet_image_replies.hint: Ends the agent turn after an image job is accepted. Disable for workflows needing further tool calls after submission. Validation errors still return normally.
